head: codex/5815-v092-final-repo-migration-plan
title: [v0.92][WP-01A][github] Finalize Agent Logic repository migration plan
body:
Closes #5815

Finalizes the executable plan for transferring the five approved repositories from danielbaustin to agent-logic. The runbook defines staged transfer order, agent-logic.ai link cutover, destination access and integration checks, rollback, and verification. asksifu remains personal and Horust remains an inactive upstream-contribution fork.

Gemini 3.1 Pro reviewed the plan. Its GHCR, Git LFS, Pages/TLS, collaborator/team, secret, OIDC, and App/webhook findings are incorporated and dispositioned in the document.

This PR is planning-only and performs no repository, organization, DNS, Pages, Actions, package, secret, billing, or AWS mutation.
